title: Moving
goal: Coordinate packing and moving, clarify where belongings go, and discuss timing or a moving-service question.

turns.speaker: A

runs.text: We're moving next Saturday. Do you have any spare boxes?

turns.en: We're moving next Saturday. Do you have any spare boxes?

turns.speaker: B

runs.text: I have three. What size do you need?

turns.en: I have three. What size do you need?

turns.speaker: A

runs.text: Small ones for books would help.

turns.en: Small ones for books would help.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: You can have these two.

turns.speaker: A

runs.text: Thanks. Could I pick them up tomorrow evening?

turns.en: Thanks. Could I pick them up tomorrow evening?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, after six works.

runs.text: distinguishes a request from an agreed change. Afterward,
The boxes are here, but we haven't unpacked
Take both parts alone, or switch roles. Use the timetable and box labels above; no physical lifting is needed.
Ask for spare boxes and arrange pickup after six tomorrow evening.
Explain where the kitchen and book boxes go. An unlabeled box appears; say you need to check it first.
Confirm the moving time and address. Ask whether the quote includes packing.
Key pickup changes to 10:30. Request an 11 a.m. start, then ask whether it has been confirmed.

“Do you have spare boxes? Could I pick them up after six?” / “Kitchen boxes go in the kitchen. I need to check this unlabeled one.” / “Could you confirm ten o'clock at eighteen Cedar Street, apartment three?” / “Would eleven be possible? Please let me know whether the change is confirmed.”

Return later with a different schedule or room assignment. Check that your instructions identify the object, destination and any unresolved timing rather than relying on vague “over there” directions.

ja: 荷物・行き先・時刻をそろえる。
note: どの箱をどこに置くか、いつ来るかを具体的に確認します。予定の変更がまだ確認中なら、確定したように扱いません。
